description: This Java interface defines the PolicyAlgorithm interface for policy enforcing algorithms, providing default implementations for methods related to permission checks and JSON view building within a testing scenario context.

classes.name: PolicyAlgorithm
classes.description: Interface for policy enforcing algorithms providing default implementation of the Enforcer interface, with methods for permission checking and JSON view construction.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the simple name of the class implementing the interface.

methods.name: hasPermissionsOnResource
methods.description: Checks if the scenario setup has unrestricted permissions on the specified resource.

methods.name: hasPermissionsOnResourceOrAnySubresource
methods.description: Checks if the scenario setup has partial permissions on the resource or any of its subresources.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JsonObject representing the given JSON fields within the context of the scenario setup.
